item.title: Xi Concludes Trump State Visit With Symbolic Final Stop
item.description: Trump and Xi Jinping ended their US summit with a National Archives visit to view historic documents before the Chinese leader departed.

item.title: US Weighs Cuban Travel Limits as Havana Criticizes Trump
item.description: The Trump administration was considering new restrictions on Cuban officials traveling to the United Nations, another step to pressure the government.

item.title: Rep. Beyer: Trump Preparing to Break Ground on Arch
item.description: Rep. Don Beyer, D-Va., said Thursday that heavy equipment at the Virginia site of President Donald Trump's proposed 250-foot triumphal arch suggests work is beginning.
